name: node-coin-flip
description: ![Screen shoot how it looks like](./img/coin-flip.png) ## How It Works ### Coin Flip API (Node.js Server) - The custom API handles the game logic and returns JSON responses. - Generates a random coin flip (50/50 chance between Heads and Tails) - Compares the user's choice with the random result - Returns a JSON response with the flip result, win/lose status, and message
